DEPENDENCY: none
ACK_REQUIRED: YES
REQUIRED_STATE: APPLIED
TARGET: AGENT_B
DETAIL_POINTERS: see FILES paths under CANON_BLUEPRINT (no embedded diff).
ACK_FORMAT: PATCH_ACK patch_id=CHANGEBOT_PLANNED_RESTART_CLASSIFICATION_R1 agent=AGENT_B state=RECEIVED|APPLIED|VERIFIED|NOT_REQUIRED note=<optional>
